# Experian

> > Experian provides credit reporting, FICO® scores, and comprehensive automotive data solutions including vehicle history, fraud prevention, and market intelligence for consumers, dealers, lenders, and manufacturers.

Experian operates as both a consumer credit bureau and a leading automotive data provider. The Experian Automotive division specializes in vehicle data analytics, credit services, and market insights powered by the North American Vehicle Database and Vehicles in Operation (VIO) data, serving the entire automotive ecosystem from OEMs to aftermarket providers.

## Key Topics

- Vehicles in Operation (VIO)
- North American Vehicle Database
- AutoCheck vehicle history reports
- FICO Score and credit reporting
- Automotive fraud prevention
- State of the Automotive Finance Market Report
- FACTA Red Flags Rule compliance
- Vehicle registration data
- Market intelligence and analytics
- Electric vehicle (EV) market trends
- First-party data management
- Credit services for auto dealers and lenders
- Department of Motor Vehicles (DMV) data
- Automotive aftermarket solutions

## Automotive Credit & Fraud Services

- [Automotive Credit Services for Dealers & Lenders](https://www.experian.com/automotive/automotive-credit-services): Credit profiles, alternative data, and fraud prevention services
- [Customer Credit Check Services for Auto Dealers](https://www.experian.com/automotive/auto-credit-dealer): Credit reports and Fraud Shield services for auto dealers
- [Automotive Credit & Fraud Services for Lenders](https://www.experian.com/automotive/automobile-lender): Finance solutions with AutoCheck and Velocity Market for lenders
- [Automotive Credit Fraud Services for Lenders](https://www.experian.com/automotive/auto-fraud): Fraud prevention with OFAC screening and Red Flags compliance

## Automotive Data & Analytics

- [Automotive Data Solutions & Insights](https://www.experian.com/automotive/auto-data): Vehicle history, analytics, APIs, and risk insights for auto industry
- [Auto Market Reporting - Formerly AutoCount](https://www.experian.com/automotive/autocount): Market intelligence dashboards with VIO and competitive analysis
- [Automotive Loan Account Monitoring Services](https://www.experian.com/automotive/auto-account-monitoring-wp): Account monitoring tools for lenders, dealers, and manufacturers
- [Automotive Consumer, Market & Credit Statistics](https://www.experian.com/automotive/affiliated-auto-industry): Allied automotive services with vehicle database and market insights
- [First Party Data Management](https://www.experian.com/automotive/first-party-data-management): Customer data verification and enrichment for dealerships

## Automotive Industry Solutions

- [About Experian Automotive](https://www.experian.com/automotive/about-experian-automotive): About Experian Automotive's data solutions for automotive industry
- [Automotive Aftermarket Vehicle & Parts Data](https://www.experian.com/automotive/auto-aftermarket): VIO data and parts intelligence for automotive aftermarket
- [Automotive Customer Loyalty Solutions](https://www.experian.com/automotive/automotive-customer-loyalty): Loyalty analytics using Velocity for OEMs and customer retention
- [Electric Vehicle Resources](https://www.experian.com/automotive/ev-resource-center): EV market insights, trends, and buyer demographics resource center
